body:
I tested this locally to confirm that the generated nupkgs work for both the Mono and Dotnet module builds.

I checked out this PR and built it with `module_mono_enabled=yes` and `export GODOT_VERSION_STATUS=dotnet3`. This is to be able to test against the Dotnet module build from https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/releases/tag/4.7-dotnet3.

After building assemblies and installing in my local nuget source (`Godot.NET.Sdk.4.7.0-dotnet.3.nupkg`), I confirmed that both flavors of the editor could compile and run Dodge the Creeps with C# (with the `dotnet3` Dotnet module build successfully performing the project conversion).
